name: Artifacts
description:
Banned artifacts:

Orb of Inhibition, Recanter's Cloak, Bird of Perception, Stoic Watchman, Emblem of Cognizance.

Rebalanced artifacts:

1) Buffed: Legs/Loins/Torso/Arms/Head/Statue of Legion, Inexhaustible Cart of Ore/Lumber.
2) Nerfed: Boots of Speed, Equestrian Gloves, Pendant of Courage, Badge of Courage, Amulet of the Undertaker, Vampire's Cowl, Dead Man's Boots.
3) Class changed to Major: Boots of Speed, Endless Sack of Gold.
4) Class changed to Minor: Pendant of Second Sight, Eversmoking Ring of Sulfur, Everflowing Crystal Cloak, Ring of Infinite Gems, Everpouring Vial of Mercury.
5) Combined artifacts:
  1. Titan's Thunder - negative effects of components are neutralised, damage of Titan's Bolt is increased to 800.
  2. Ring of the Magi - additionally increases damage from hero's spells by 30%.
  3. Cloak of the Undead Knight - 15% of battlefield dead are resurrected as Skeletons. If hero already has the Necromancy skill then the percentages are added to the skill.
author: wnukos
